title: Data Flows and Colonial Regimes in Africa: A Critical Analysis of the Colonial Futurities Embedded in AI Recommendation Algorithms
reasoning: The paper's central argument focuses on the ethical implications of AI in Africa, explicitly critiquing Western-centric ethical frameworks and advocating for decolonial approaches grounded in African philosophies, epistemologies, and worldviews.
